original.description: Pre-war portrait of Albrecht, Duke of Württemberg, in uniform, by the Stuttgart photographer Alfred Hirrlinger; reproduced in the magazine "Daheim", Jg. 51, Nr. 16, 16 January 1915, p. 9.
original.archive: Wikimedia Commons; the record cites "Daheim", Jg. 51, Nr. 16, 16 January 1915, p. 9
original.licence: public domain (Commons record: LicenseShortName "Public domain"). Hirrlinger died in 1938, so the work is out of copyright on life + 70.

colorization.status: not colorized. Recommendation: colorize — Württemberg general officer’s uniform, and the resolution supports it.

caption: Albrecht, Duke of Württemberg, commander of the German Fourth Army in the Ardennes in August 1914.
credit: Original photograph: Alfred Hirrlinger, c. 1910; published in "Daheim", 16 January 1915; via Wikimedia Commons; public domain.
notes: Verified 2026-08-24 against the Commons file record via the MediaWiki API. A pre-war portrait used for a 1914 command — the caption states the command, not the date of the likeness.
